overall: MARGINAL overall: calm on the Coron side and in the south, a short west-side lull this afternoon, then wind rebuilds in the west tonight
limiterDetail: The main limiter is wind in the west: Nangalao and Ciron 12 kt now (gusts 17), Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 10 kt, Barangonan 9 kt, all building to 14–18 kt from about 7–9 PM and staying there through Friday morning. Alava and Binudac rise to 12–13 kt about 9 PM–1 AM. The Coron side, Culion, Galoc, Maglalambay and Panlaitan stay at 8 kt or less, and Tara, Decabobo and Turda at 4 kt or less. Current is the second factor: the Tara and Turda pickup about 7–10 PM (1.0–1.1 kt) and the west overnight about 1–5 AM Fri. Rain is light: showers now at Linapacan and Barangonan (1.1–1.2 mm/h), Cabunlawan and Decabaitot about 6–8 PM (0.8 mm/h), and drizzle on the Coron side about 3–5 PM and midnight–3 AM. 24h totals are 1.2–7.0 mm.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: no gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. The feed still references the Tropical Cyclone Alert for Typhoon Rosal (Champi) , not covering Palawan. The latest items (to Mon 26 Oct 5:26 AM PHT) are final general flood advisories for the Visayas regions, none covering Palawan.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: The west-side wind comes back harder tonight and holds into Friday midday. Cabunlawan and Decabaitot climb from 10 kt now to 16–18 kt from about 9 PM (gusts to 23), Barangonan to 15–17 kt, and Nangalao and Ciron stay 14–16 kt overnight. They only ease to 13–15 kt by Friday noon. Linapacan also picks up to 12–13 kt from about 9 PM through Friday 1 PM (this morning it was 8–12 kt).

So Saturday 31 arrivals trim to NEAR NORMAL (was recovering to normal): the Coron side and the south fish fully on Friday, but the west and Linapacan lose Friday morning. Today stays SOFT and Friday stays SLIGHTLY SOFT. Saturday itself is now breezier (11 kt, gusts 17) but drier (2.9 mm, was 9.2). The grounds now read 5 GOOD / 11 MARGINAL / 0 POOR / 0 VERY POOR (was 8 / 7 / 1 / 0 this morning). PAGASA has nothing for Palawan.
